lyrics: Sun on the river, picnic day!
Ollie smiles, Come this way!
Basket, blanket, water too—
How can three friends safely cruise?
character_actions: friends enter from the bank
Ollie points to the empty raft
Fern raises one balance token
scenes.camera: slow 1.00 to 1.05 push toward the raft
scenes.animation: three explicit states; friends enter, inspect, then point
scenes.transition: hard cut on Ollie's pointing action

lyrics: Basket, blanket, jug go left.
Oops, that side has all the heft!
Low left and high right—
Keep it tied and keep it flat.
character_actions: friends place loads one by one on the left
raft tilts mildly
friends pause and compare the rims
scenes.animation: one load moves at a time; tilt settles without bouncing

lyrics: Ollie rolls the blue jug right.
Willa watches, eyes so bright.
Left and right now share the load—
Level like a little road!
scenes.background: same dock with level comparison visible
character_actions: Ollie braces and rolls the jug right
raft slowly levels
Fern holds token horizontally
scenes.camera: follow jug left-to-right, settle on level rims
scenes.animation: anticipation, curved jug roll, follow-through and still comparison

lyrics: Willa boards and sits down low.
Clip the straps before we go.
One friend moves, the others wait—
Patient turns will keep things straight.
character_actions: Willa steps aboard while low
Willa straps the jug
Ollie straps the basket while Fern waits
scenes.camera: medium push toward hands and straps
scenes.animation: boarding and fastening are separate readable actions
scenes.transition: L-cut of strap click by 12 frames

lyrics: Left and right, then find the middle,
Slow and steady, just a little.
Sit down low and help it glide,
Balance, balance, side to side!
character_actions: friends board one at a time
all sit along the centre blanket
friends tap the balance rhythm
scenes.camera: symmetrical wide hold with a small 1.04 push on final line
scenes.animation: three friends gesture left, right, then centre without standing
scenes.transition: hard cut as rope is safely released by off-screen grown-up helper cue

lyrics: Fern sees ducks and waves hello.
One side dips—so soft and slow.
Point to centre, can you show?
Back we scoot before we row.
character_actions: Fern turns toward ducks
Fern shifts inside the left rim and waves
Ollie points calmly to centre
scenes.camera: gentle follow to Fern, no rotation
scenes.animation: mild readable tilt; nobody stands or leaves raft
scenes.music_notes: brief suspended chord under six-second pointing prompt

lyrics: Fern slides back—now centre, please.
Level raft and laughing breeze.
Paddles dip on either side—
Together, together, glide, glide, glide!
character_actions: Fern scoots to centre
raft returns level
Ollie and Willa make matching shallow paddle strokes
scenes.camera: left-to-right follow with foreground reeds at 1.2x parallax
scenes.animation: matched paddle arcs land on beats; Fern remains seated
scenes.music_notes: symmetric paddle rhythm and widening harmony

lyrics: Ropes are tied at Picnic Bay.
Unload first—that is the way.
Hand to hand the basket goes,
Then the blanket softly rolls.
character_actions: raft is secured with two ropes
Ollie and seated Willa pass basket hand-to-hand
Fern receives the blanket on shore
scenes.camera: medium follow from raft to shore
scenes.animation: basket and blanket move separately; raft remains level
scenes.transition: J-cut of finale shaker by 8 frames

lyrics: Left and right, then find the middle,
Slow and steady, just a little.
Friends who listen, friends who guide—
Balance, balance, side by side!
scenes.background: sunset picnic under willow lights, empty raft tied behind
character_actions: friends arrange exactly three cups
Ollie starts the tongue drum
all three sing and sway at the picnic
scenes.camera: slow celebratory pull-back revealing the whole picnic
scenes.animation: cup placement, drum start and final singing are distinct states
scenes.music_notes: full chorus, widest harmony, then six-second instrumental resolve
scenes.transition: hard cut to final-only end card at 144 seconds

scenes.background: soft river sunset derived from the finale
character_actions: one gentle final wave, then hold
scenes.animation: one wave only; no looping text
scenes.music_notes: instrumental tonic resolve and clean fade
